Description: The Sparkswall is an uncommon Ring that shields the wearer from Lightning.

Name: The Whispering Promise
Description: The Whispering Promise is an uncommon Ring that grants a bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws to creatures healed by the wearer.

Description: After Death Do Us Part is a rare Ring which allows its wearer to regain half their hit points after being  Downed, but be cursed with  Shadow Possession.

Name: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel
Description: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel is a rare Ring that grants the wearer the ability to cast illusion or enchantment spells as a bonus action after hitting a creature with a weapon attack.

Name: Fetish of Callarduran Smoothhands
Description: The Fetish of Callarduran Smoothhands is a rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast the Invisibility spell once per Long Rest.

Name: Keepsake Ring
Description: Keepsake Ring is a rare Ring that allows its wearer to cast  Dominate Beast as a 5th level spell once per Long Rest.

Name: Ring of Arcane Synergy
Description: Ring of Arcane Synergy is a rare Ring. It grants Arcane Synergy when the wearer deals damage with a cantrip.

Name: Ring of Blink
Description: The Ring of Blink is a rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast  Blink once per Long Rest.

Name: Ring of Exalted Marrow
Description: Ring of Exalted Marrow is a rare Ring that grants the wearer the ability to cast Exhort the Risen and Ghoulish Touch.

Name: Ring of Free Action
Description: Ring of Free Action is a rare Ring which allows the wearer to ignore the effects of Difficult Terrain and confers immunity to  Paralysis and being  Restrained.

Name: Ring of Mind-Shielding
Description: The Ring of Mind-Shielding is a rare Ring that gives advantage on saving throws against being Charmed.

Name: Ring of Poison Resistance
Description: The Ring of Poison Resistance is a rare Ring that grants the wearer Resistance to ⁠Poison damage.

Name: Ring of Protection
Description: The Ring of Protection is a rare Ring that grants the wearer a bonus to  Armour Class and  Saving throws.

Name: Ring of Truthfulness
Description: Ring of Truthfulness is a rare ring that grants its wearer  Advantage on  Insight checks.

Name: Ring of Twilight
Description: The Ring of Twilight is a rare Ring that increases the wearer's Armour Class while obscured.

Name: Risky Ring
Description: The Risky Ring is a rare Ring. The wearer gains  Advantage on  Attack rolls but receives  Disadvantage on  Saving throws.

Name: Shifting Corpus Ring
Description: The Shifting Corpus Ring is a rare Ring that grants the ability to cast Invisibility and Blur once per Long Rest.

Name: Till Death Do Us Part
Description: Til Death Do Us Part is a rare Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast  Beacon of Hope.

Name: True Love's Caress
Description: True Love's Caress is one of a matching pair of Rings that grants the wearer  Warding Bond.

Name: True Love's Embrace
Description: True Love's Embrace is one of a matching pair of Rings that lets the wearer cast  Warding Bond.

Name: Burnished Ring
Description: The Burnished Ring is a very rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast  Paralyzing Ray once per Long Rest.

Name: Crypt Lord Ring
Description: Crypt Lord Ring is a very rare Ring that allows the wearer to cast  Create Undead once per Long Rest.

Name: Killer's Sweetheart
Description: Killer's Sweetheart is a very rare Ring that makes the wearer's next Attack Roll a critical hit after killing a creature, once per Long Rest.

Name: Orphic Ring
Description: Orphic Ring is a very rare ring that grants its wearer the  Confusion (level 5) spell on a long rest cooldown.

Name: Ring of Evasion
Description: Ring of Evasion is a very rare Ring that grants the wearer Dextrous Evasion.

Name: Ring of Feywild Sparks
Description: Ring of Feywild Sparks is a very rare Ring. It forces Wild Magic Surges to always trigger while  Tides of Chaos feature is active. It also grants a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC.

Name: Ring of Regeneration
Description: Ring of Regeneration is a very rare Ring that heals the wearer at the beginning of their turn while in combat.

Name: Guiding Light
Description: The Guiding Light is an story-related Ring that allows the wearer to cast the  Light cantrip.

Name: Aberration Hunters' Amulet
Description: The Aberration Hunters' Amulet is an uncommon Amulet. It grants Githyanki wearing it  Advantage on Intelligence Saving Throws and aberrations have  Disadvantage on attacks against them. The wielder can gain  Advantage on Attack Rolls against Aberrations for 3 turns, once per Short Rest.[See: Bugs]

Name: Absolute Confidence Amulet
Description: The Absolute Confidence Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that grants the wearer a +1 bonus to Performance checks at the cost of -1 to Intimidation checks.

Name: Absolute's Talisman
Description: Absolute's Talisman is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast a self-only version of Aid, and grants Advantage on Death Saving Throws if they bear the Absolute's Brand.

Name: Amulet of Elemental Torment
Description: The Amulet of Elemental Torment is an uncommon Amulet that channels the effects of certain Surfaces into the wearer's spells.

Name: Amulet of Misty Step
Description: Amulet of Misty Step is an uncommon amulet that grants its wearer the Misty Step spell on a short rest cooldown.

Name: Amulet of Selûne's Chosen
Description: The Amulet of Selûne's Chosen is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Selûne's Dream once per Long Rest.

Name: Amulet of Silvanus
Description: The Amulet of Silvanus is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Lesser Restoration once per Short Rest.

Name: Amulet of the Unworthy
Description: The Amulet of the Unworthy is an uncommon Amulet that protects the wearer from ⁠Slashing damage, but leaves them vulnerable to ⁠Bludgeoning damage.

Name: Beastmaster's Chain
Description: Beastmaster's Chain is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Animal Friendship once per Long Rest.

Name: Broodmother's Revenge
Description: The Broodmother's Revenge is an uncommon Amulet. It coats the wearer's weapon in poison whenever they are healed.

Name: Fireheart
Description: Fireheart is an uncommon Amulet that grants the wearer 2 turns of  Heat when they take Fire damage.

Name: Frost Prince
Description: Frost Prince is an uncommon Amulet which grants the wearer the ability to cast the  Ice Knife spell.

Name: Hammergrim Mist Amulet
Description: The Hammergrim Mist Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that grants the wearer the ability to cast the  Fog Cloud spell.

Name: Kill Collar
Description: Kill Collar is an uncommon Amulet that represents the collars used by Gortash to keep the Gondians within the Iron Foundry in check.

Name: Komira's Locket
Description: Komira's Locket is an uncommon Amulet given to the party by  Arabella's parents.Grants its wearer the ability to cast  Dancing Lights.

Name: Moondrop Pendant
Description: The Moondrop Pendant is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to avoid provoking Attacks of Opportunity when below 50% hit points.

Name: Necklace of Elemental Augmentation
Description: Necklace of Elemental Augmentation is an uncommon Amulet that adds the Spellcasting Modifier to the damage when the wearer uses elemental damage with a cantrip.

Name: Pearl of Power Amulet
Description: The Pearl of Power Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wielder to restore a spell slot of 3rd level or lower once per Long Rest.

Name: Psychic Spark
Description: Psychic Spark is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast a stronger version of  Magic Missile.

Name: Shar's Temptation
Description: Shar's Temptation is an Amulet that allows its wearer to cast  Charm Person once per Short Rest.

Name: Silver Pendant
Description: Silver Pendant is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Guidance.

Name: Spineshudder Amulet
Description: Spineshudder Amulet is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to inflict Reverberation when dealing damage with ranged spell attacks.

Name: Tarnished Charm
Description: The Tarnished Charm is an uncommon amulet that reduces the DC of the wearer's death saving throws.

Name: The Blast Pendant
Description: The Blast Pendant is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to focus and discharge their Lightning Charges to strengthen their next lightning spell.

Name: The Ever-Seeing Eye
Description: The Ever-Seeing Eye is an uncommon Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Protection from Evil and Good once per Short Rest.

Name: Amulet of Branding
Description: The Amulet of Branding is a rare Amulet which allows the wearer to cast Brand the Weak once per Long Rest.

Name: Amulet of Restoration
Description: Amulet of Restoration is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Healing Word and  Mass Healing Word once per Long Rest.

Name: Amulet of the Drunkard
Description: Amulet of the Drunkard is a rare amulet. It increases the duration of Drunk to 5 turns and causes the wearer to regain 2d4 hit points once, during the first turn of  Drunk that occurs with this item equipped.

Name: Amulet of the Harpers
Description: Amulet of the Harpers is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Shield once per Long Rest and grants Advantage with Wisdom Saving Throws.

Name: Champion's Chain
Description: Champion's Chain is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to grant an ally a bonus to Intimidation.

Name: Chancer's Carcanet
Description: Chancer's Carcanet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to use a reaction to make an  Attack roll or  Saving throw with  Advantage, once per Long Rest.

Name: Envoy's Amulet
Description: Envoy's Amulet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to grant an ally a bonus to Persuasion.

Name: Periapt of Wound Closure
Description: Periapt of Wound Closure is a rare Amulet. Its wearer is automatically stabilised if  Downed at the start of their turn and the maximum the amount of hit points are restored to them when they receive healing.

Name: Sentient Amulet (Rare)
Spells: Shatter, Talk to the Sentient Amulet, Ki Restoration (Lesser)
Description: Sentient Amulet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Shatter once per Short Rest (with a drawback) and  Ki Restoration (Lesser) once per Long Rest.

Name: Spell Savant Amulet
Description: Spell Savant Amulet is a rare Amulet that grants an additional Level 2 spell slot.

Name: Strange Tendril Amulet
Description: Strange Tendril Amulet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Evard's Black Tentacles once per Long Rest.

Name: Surgeon's Subjugation Amulet
Description: The Surgeon's Subjugation Amulet is a rare Amulet that, once per Long Rest, paralyses a humanoid on a Critical Hit.

Name: The Amulet of Lost Voices
Description: The Amulet of Lost Voices is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Speak with Dead once per Long Rest.

Name: Uncovered Mysteries
Description: Uncovered Mysteries is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Detect Thoughts once per Long Rest.

Name: Amulet of Greater Health
Description: Amulet of Greater Health is a very rare Amulet that can be obtained from the House of Hope.

Name: Amulet of the Devout
Description: The Amulet of the Devout is a very rare Amulet. It grants the wearer a +2 bonus to Spell Save DC and, if the wearer has access to it, an additional use of  Channel Divinity Charge.

Name: Amulet of Windrider
Spells: Ride the Winds, Gust of Wind
Description: Amulet of Windrider is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Ride the Winds and Gust of Wind. It is one of the rewards of the quest Save Vanra.

Name: Corvid Token
Description: Corvid Token is a very rare Amulet that increases jump distance and flying speed, grants the Polymorph: Dire Raven action, and grants Feather Fall to the wearer, which persists while Polymorphed or Wild Shaped.

Name: Fey Semblance Amulet
Description: Fey Semblance Amulet is a very rare Amulet that gives the user advantage on all mental saving throws.

Name: Khalid's Gift
Description: Khalid's Gift is a very rare Amulet that was gifted to Jaheira by Khalid and stored away in the basement of her home. While wearing it, Jaheira cannot be cursed.

Name: Sentient Amulet (Very Rare)
Description: Sentient Amulet is a very rare Amulet which allows the wearer to cast  Shatter once per Long Rest and  Ki Restoration (Greater) once per Long Rest. It is a possible reward for the quest Help the Cursed Monk.

Name: Spellcrux Amulet
Description: Spellcrux Amulet is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to restore any one spell slot once per Long Rest.

Name: The Spectator Eyes
Description: The Spectator Eyes is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast  Ray of Fear and  Wounding Ray once per Long Rest.

Name: Tressym Collar
Description: Tressym Collar is a very rare Amulet which allows the wearer to cast  Telekinesis once per Long Rest.

Name: Unflinching Protector Amulet
Description: Unflinching Protector Amulet is a very rare Amulet that can be obtained from Ptaris.

Name: Amulet of Bhaal
Description: Amulet of Bhaal is a story-related Amulet which allows the wearer to inflict  Bleeding when hitting targets with maximum hit points. It also grants access to the Bhaal Temple.

Description: A Studded Shield is a common Shield.

Description: The Training Shield is a common Shield that is reserved for practice instead of real fighting. Considering it isn't sold anywhere, requires stealing and is inferior to other shields it can be considered little more than junk.

Name: Wooden Shield
Description: A Wooden Shield is a common Shield.

Name: Absolute's Warboard
Description: Absolute's Warboard is an uncommon Shield that improves a branded wearer's Saving Throws and allows them to cast Heroism once per Long Rest.

Name: Gloomstrand Shield
Description: Gloomstrand Shield is an uncommon Shield that adds +1 to Stealth

Name: Glowing Shield
Description: The Glowing Shield is an uncommon Shield that grants its user Temporary Hit Points once per Short Rest when they take damage while greatly injured.

Name: Ironvine Shield

Name: Safeguard Shield
Description: The Safeguard Shield is an uncommon Shield that grants you Saving Throws +1

Name: The Real Sparky Sparkswall
Description: The Real Sparky Sparkswall is an uncommon Shield that allows the wearer to create a Lightning Aura.

Name: Watcher's Shield
Description: Watcher's Shield is an uncommon Shield that gives the wielder Advantage on Perception Checks.

Name: Wood Woad Shield
Description: Wood Woad Shield is an uncommon Shield found on Wood Woads and grants its wearer the ability to cast Woad's Ensnaring Strike.

Name: Absolute's Protector
Description: Absolute's Protector is a rare Shield that reduces damage from spells by 1 if the user bears the mark of the Absolute, grants Shield Bash, and allows the wielder to cast Fire Shield: Chill once per Long Rest.

Name: Adamantine Shield
Description: Adamantine Shield is a rare Shield that sends enemies Reeling when they miss you with a melee attack.

Name: Iron-Banded Shield +1
Description: Iron-Banded Shield +1 is a rare Shield with an enchantment increasing its Armour Class bonus.

Name: Justiciar's Greatshield
Description: Justiciar's Greatshield is a rare Shield that allows the wielder to cast Darkness Cloak to hide themselves, and gains advantage on Perception checks.

Name: Ketheric's Shield
Description: Ketheric's Shield is a rare Shield that grants the action Shield Bash and improves your spellcasting-related rolls. It also gives you Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

Name: Sentinel Shield
Description: Sentinel Shield is a rare Shield that provides the user +3 to Initiative rolls and advantage on Perception checks

Name: Shield +1
Description: A Shield +1 is a rare Shield with an enchantment increasing its  Armour Class bonus.

Name: Shield of Scorching Reprisal
Description: Shield of Scorching Reprisal is a rare Shield that grants Fire Resistance, allows one to Shield Bash, and also apply Blazing Retaliation.

Name: Shield of Shielding
Description: Shield of Shielding is a rare Shield that allows the wearer to cast Shield and use Shield Bash.

Name: Studded Shield +1
Description: A Studded Shield +1 is a rare Shield with an enchantment increasing its  Armour Class bonus.

Name: Abdel's Trusted Shield
Description: Abdel's Trusted Shield is a very rare Shield that allows the wearer to cast Protection from Missiles once per Short Rest, as well as use Shield Bash.

Name: Shield of Devotion
Spells: Shield Blow, Shield of Devotion: Aid
Description: Shield of Devotion is a very rare Shield that grants a Level 1 Spell Slot, Shield Bash and allows the wielder to cast Shield of Devotion: Aid at Level 3 Spell once per Long Rest.

Name: Shield of the Undevout
Description: Shield of the Undevout is a very rare Shield that applies Disadvantage on Frightened Saving Throws to your foes and grants an additional level 1 spell slot. It also grants Shield Bash.

Name: Swires' Sledboard
Description: Swires' Sledboard is a very rare shield that grants the wearer Force Conduit at the start of combat. It also grants Shield Bash.

Name: Viconia's Walking Fortress
Spells: Bulwark Rebuke, Reflective Shell, Warding Bond
Description: Viconia's Walking Fortress is a legendary shield that can deal Force damage to the attacker when hit. Gives Advantage on saving throws against spells and Disadvantage to spell attacks made against the wearer.

Name: Simple Robe
Description: A Robe is a common piece of Clothing.

Description: Barbarian Clothes are a common piece of Clothing.

Description: The Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo is an uncommon piece of Clothing that allows the wearer to counter attack an enemy that misses them, so long as Patient Defence is active.

Name: Bided Time
Description: Bided Time is a set of uncommon Clothing that causes the wearer to gain Arcane Charge whenever they are hit by a melee attack.

Name: Bloodguzzler Garb
Description: The Bloodguzzler Garb is an uncommon piece of Clothing that grants its wearer Wrath when an enemy damages the wearer.

Name: Cloth Armour
Description: Cloth Armour is an uncommon piece of Clothing that grants Wrath when an enemy damages the wearer.

Description: Drunken Cloth is a rare piece of Clothing that grants the wearer Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws while Drunk. They also gain temporary hit points at the start of each turn.

Description: The Enraging Heart Garb is a rare piece of Clothing that grants Wrath while the wearer is Raging. It also increases Constitution by 2.

Name: Garb of the Land and Sky
Description: Garb of the Land and Sky is rare Clothing that grants the wearer Blade Ward when using Patient Defence. When using Step of the Wind, the wearer's next Attack Roll has Advantage and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage.

Description: Icebite Robe is a rare piece of Clothing. It grants the wearer Resistance to Cold damage and allows them to cast Armour of Agathys as a 3rd level spell once per Long Rest.

Description: Mutilated Carapace is a rare piece of Clothing that grants its wearer a bonus to Attack Rolls and damage rolls while being disguised, as well as Advantage on Deception and Persuasion Ability Checks.

Description: Obsidian Laced Robe is rare piece of Clothing that deals Fire damage to enemies on a successful Saving Throw against their spells, and grants its wearer resistance to Fire damage.

Name: Robe of Exquisite Focus
Description: The Robe of Exquisite Focus is a rare piece of Clothing that increases its wearer's Spell Save DC.

Name: Shelter of Athkatla
Description: Shelter of Athkatla is a rare Clothing that grants the wearer Advantage against spell Saving Throws, and grants the ability to cast Mirror Image

Features: Cat's Grace, Nimble As a Cat

Name: The Mighty Cloth
Description: The Mighty Cloth is a rare piece of Clothing that gives its wearer +2 Strength (up to 20) and the Bull's Strength condition. Also grants the wearer the Bull Rush class action.

Name: The Protecty Sparkswall
Description: The Protecty Sparkswall is a rare Clothing that increases the wearer's defences while they have Lightning Charges and grants a +1 bonus to their Spell Save DC.

Name: Viconia's Priestess Robe
Description: Viconia's Priestess Robe is a rare Clothing that grants the wearer Advantage on Stealth checks while Obscured, and enhances Shield of Faith to give a +2 to all Saving Throws as well.

Name: Bonespike Garb
Description: Bonespike Garb is a very rare Clothing that grants temporary hit points when using Rage, and reduces incoming damage by 2. Attackers receive Piercing damage when the wearer is struck.

Name: Infernal Robe
Description: Infernal Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing that makes its wearer resistant to Fire damage and grants the Fire Shield (Warm) at level 4, once per Long Rest.

Name: Moon Devotion Robe
Description: Moon Devotion Robe is a very rare Clothing that grants Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws and grants the ability to cast Produce Flame and Lunar Bulwark.

Name: Potent Robe
Description: The Potent Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing that uses the wearer's Charisma modifier to increase their cantrips' damage as well as give them temporary hit points.

Name: Robe of Supreme Defences
Description: The Robe of Supreme Defences is a very rare Clothing that adds your Spellcasting Modifier to your Saving Throws, when you are concentrating on a spell.

Name: Robe of the Weave
Features: Weave Eater, Arcane Enchantment (Robe of the Weave)

Name: Veil of the Morning
Features: Let The Undead Blanch With Fear

Name: Vest of Soul Rejuvenation
Description: Vest of Soul Rejuvenation is a very rare Clothing that allows the wearer to heal on a successful saving throw against a spell, and can make an Unarmed Attack against any attacker that misses, using a Reaction.

Description: Wavemother's Robe is a very rare Clothing which grants the wearer Resistance to Fire and Cold damage. The wearer also heals while standing in water and can cast Create or Destroy Water.

Description: Cape of the Red Prince is a common Cloak.

Name: Cloak of Cunning Brume
Description: Cloak of Cunning Brume is an uncommon Cloak which grants the user a  smokescreen cloud effect when trying to  Disengage.

Name: Cloak of Elemental Absorption
Description: Cloak of Elemental Absorption is an uncommon Cloak that allows the wearer to absorb a small amount of magical damage, and add it to their next attack.

Name: Cloak of Protection
Description: Cloak of Protection is an uncommon Cloak which grants the user +1  Armour Class and +1 to  Saving throws

Name: Fleshmelter Cloak
Description: Fleshmelter Cloak is an uncommon Cloak. It deals acid damage to creatures that deal melee damage to the wearer.

Name: Thunderskin Cloak
Description: Thunderskin Cloak is an uncommon Cloak which has a chance to  Daze creatures that are  Reverberating when they damage the wearer.

Name: Vivacious Cloak
Description: Vivacious Cloak is an uncommon Cloak that grants the wearer 8 temporary Hit Points when casting a spell in melee.

Name: Cloak of Displacement
Description: Cloak of Displacement is a rare Cloak that, every turn, subjects enemy attacks against its wearer to Disadvantage until the wearer takes damage.

Name: Derivation Cloak
Description: Derivation Cloak is a rare Cloak which heals the wearer for 1d4 Hit Points when they Poison a foe.

Name: The Deathstalker Mantle
Description: The Deathstalker Mantle is a rare Cloak that turns the wearer Invisible for 2 turns after killing an enemy.

Name: Wavemother's Cloak
Description: Wavemother's Cloak is a rare Cloak that grants its wearer Water Layer Protection every turn.

Name: Cloak of the Weave
Description: Cloak of the Weave is a very rare Cloak that allows the wearer to absorb a small amount of magical damage, and add it to their next attack. It also gives better Spell Save DC and Spell Attack Rolls.

Name: Mantle of the Holy Warrior
Description: The Mantle of the Holy Warrior is a Very Rare Cloak that grants the wearer the ability to cast Crusader's Mantle.

Name: Nymph Cloak
Description: Nymph Cloak is a very rare Cloak that allows the wearer to cast Dominate Person once per Long Rest.

Name: Shade-Slayer Cloak
Description: Shade-Slayer Cloak is a very rare Cloak that reduces the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while hiding.

Description: Drow Leather Gloves are a common pair of Gloves worn by the Drow.

Description: Druidic Gloves are a common pair of Gloves.

Description: The Gloves of Heroism are an uncommon pair of gloves that grants their wearer Heroism whenever using Channel Oath spells.

Name: Gloves of Power
Description: Gloves of Power are an uncommon pair of Gloves that allows the wearer to inflict Bane on weapon attacks.

Name: Gloves of the Growling Underdog
Description: The Gloves of the Growling Underdog are an uncommon pair of Gloves which grant the wearer  Advantage on their melee attack rolls while surrounded by 2 or more enemies.

Name: Gloves of Thievery
Description: Gloves of Thievery are an uncommon pair of Gloves that give the wearer  Advantage on Sleight of Hand checks.

Name: Hellrider's Pride
Description: The Hellrider's Pride are an uncommon pair of Gloves that grant a creature resistance to the physical damage of weapon attacks when healed by the wearer of these gauntlets.

Name: Herbalist's Gloves
Description: The Herbalist's Gloves are an uncommon pair of gloves that cleanse poison from those the wearer heals.

Name: Ichorous Gloves
Description: Ichorous Gloves are an uncommon set of Gloves that can inflict Noxious Fumes on targets that are dealt Acid damage.

Name: Knock Knuckle Gloves
Description: Knock Knuckle Gloves are uncommon Gloves that grant the spell Knock and increases Sleight of Hand by 1.

Name: Luminous Gloves
Description: The Luminous Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves that causes the wearer's Radiant damage to afflict struck foes with the Radiating Orb condition.

Name: Reason's Grasp
Description: Reason's Grasp are an uncommon pair of Gloves that give the wearer Temporary Hit Points if they choose to end their Rage.

Name: Thermoarcanic Gloves
Description: Thermoarcanic Gloves are an uncommon pair of Gloves which grants the wearer 2 turns of Heat whenever they deal Fire damage.

Name: Unlucky Thief's Gloves
Description: Unlucky Thief's Gloves are an uncommon Gloves that grants the wearer +2 to Sleight of Hand checks.

Name: Winter's Clutches
Description: The Winter's Clutches are an uncommon pair of Gloves that allow the wearer to inflict Encrusted with Frost on enemies whenever they deal Cold damage.

Name: Bracers of Defence
Description: Bracers of Defence are a rare pair of Gloves which increase the wearer's Armour Class by 2 when unarmoured and not holding a shield.

Name: Cerebral Citadel Gloves
Description: The Cerebral Citadel Gloves are rare gloves that provide a bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws when a character Charms or Frightens a creature.

Name: Cindersnap Gloves
Description: Cindersnap Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grants the spell Protection from Missiles.

Name: Craterflesh Gloves
Description: Craterflesh Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that deal additional Force damage on a Critical Hit.

Name: Daredevil Gloves
Description: Daredevil Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that enhance Spell Attack Rolls and enable casting spells without Disadvantage even when adjacent to an enemy.

Name: Dark Displacement Gloves
Description: Dark Displacement Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grant their wearer +1 Sleight of Hand. They also give a +1 Attack Roll bonus when attacking with thrown weapons and swap positions with these targets if they fail a Dexterity Saving Throw.

Name: Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Rare)
Description: The Dark Justiciar Gauntlets are a rare pair of Gloves that cause weapon attacks to deal an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage. It also grants better Strength Saving Throws and allows the wearer to cast Beckoning Darkness once per turn.

Name: Flawed Helldusk Gloves
Description: Flawed Helldusk Gloves are a rare pair of gloves that grant 1d4 Fire damage to weapon attacks. Unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage and have a chance to inflict Bleeding.

Name: Gloves of Battlemage's Power
Description: Gloves of Battlemage's Power is a set of rare Gloves. They allow the wearer to gain Arcane Acuity whenever they hit a target with a spell or cantrip that uses a weapon.

Name: Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle
Description: The Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle are a rare pair of Gloves that give the wearer Fire damage to their unarmed attacks and the ability to cast Scorching Ray once per Long Rest.

Name: Gloves of Crushing
Description: Gloves of Crushing are rare gloves that enhance unarmed attack rolls and grant bonus Bludgeoning damage to unarmed attacks.

Name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
Description: Gloves of Missile Snaring is a rare pair of gloves that allows the wearer to use Missile Snaring to reduce incoming ranged damage as a Reaction.

Name: Gloves of the Automaton
Description: The Gloves of the Automaton are a rare pair of Gloves which, when activated, cause the wearer to be treated as a Construct and grant Advantage on weapon attacks for 10 turns.

Name: Gloves of the Balanced Hands
Description: Gloves of the Balanced Hands are a rare pair of Gloves that adds the wearer's Ability Modifier to damage when they make an attack with their off-hand weapon.

Name: Gloves of The Duellist
Description: Gloves of The Duellist are a rare pair of Gloves that enhance melee weapon Attack Rolls when the wearer only holds one weapon in the main hand.

Name: Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo
Description: Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo is a rare pair of gloves that deals additional damage with Throw attacks and Improvised Weapons attacks.

Name: Jhannyl's Gloves
Description: Jhannyl's Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that lets the wearer automatically cast Lesser Restoration on themselves when they become Blinded, Paralysed or Poisoned.

Name: Martial Exertion Gloves
Description: Martial Exertion Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that allows the wearer to gain an additional attack and double its movement speed for one turn at the cost of taking some damage.

Name: Nimblefinger Gloves
Description: Nimblefinger Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grant a Dexterity bonus to Gnomes, Halflings, and Dwarves, and a bonus to Sleight of Hand.

Name: Poisoner's Gloves
Description: Poisoner's Gloves are a rare set of Gloves which has a chance to poison a target every time it receives Poison damage.

Name: Raven Gloves
Description: Raven Gloves are rare Gloves that allow the wearer to summon a Raven.

Name: Seraphic Pugilist Gloves
Description: Seraphic Pugilist Gloves are a rare pair of gloves that give additional 1d4 Radiant damage to unarmed attacks and give the ability to cast Guiding Bolt.

Name: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves
Description: The Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that give additional Force damage to unarmed attacks and allows the wearer to cast Fear once per Long Rest.

Name: Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves
Description: Snow-Dusted Monastery Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that cause the wearer's unarmed attacks to deal an additional 1d4 Cold damage. It also grants the ability to cast Ice Knife as a 3rd level spell once per Long Rest.

Name: Spellseeking Gloves
Description: Spellseeking Gloves are rare Gloves that allow the wearer to spend a Sorcery Point to gain Advantage when making a spell attack roll.

Description: The Gemini Gloves are a very rare pair of Gloves. They grant the wearer the ability to cast Cantrips which can target foes or allies twice.
